Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     Pages one folder down (posts/) reach the site root with a `root` of \"../\".\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.db import connect\nfrom app.rendering import render_body\n\n# The wording comes from notes/client-brief.md. Make no other claim about ASA.\nWELCOME = (\n    \"ASA is a Kenyon student group primarily for African students and students \"\n    \"with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African \"\n    \"cultures and community.\"\n)\nHOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS = 5\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\na:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\nimg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }\n.card { border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; margin-block: 1rem; }\n.card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }\n.meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9rem; opacity: 0.8; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _day(timestamp: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A stored UTC timestamp as (\"2026-09-28\", \"28 September 2026\").\"\"\"\n    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)\n    return moment.date().isoformat(), f\"{moment.day} {moment:%B %Y}\"\n\n\ndef _published_posts(database: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Published Posts only, newest First-published date first.\n\n    Ordered by First-published date, not by edit time, so a correction never\n    moves a Post. The byline is the Author's Display name; the Username is not\n    even selected.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(database)) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT posts.title, posts.slug, posts.body, posts.updated_at, \"\n            \"posts.first_published_at, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n            \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id \"\n            \"WHERE posts.status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY posts.first_published_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    return [_post_for_template(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef _post_for_template(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:\n    posted_iso, posted_label = _day(row[\"first_published_at\"])\n    post = {\n        \"title\": row[\"title\"], \"slug\": row[\"slug\"], \"author_name\": row[\"author_name\"],\n        \"body_html\": render_body(row[\"body\"]),\n        \"posted_iso\": posted_iso, \"posted_label\": posted_label,\n        \"updated_iso\": None, \"updated_label\": None,\n    }\n    if row[\"updated_at\"] > row[\"first_published_at\"]:\n        post[\"updated_iso\"], post[\"updated_label\"] = _day(row[\"updated_at\"])\n    return post\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    published = _published_posts(database)\n    common = {\"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE}\n\n    def write(name: str, template: str, **context) -> None:\n        (out / name).write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n            **common, **context))\n\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    write(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=\"\",\n          welcome=WELCOME, posts=published[:HOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS])\n    write(\"announcements.html\", \"public/announcements.html\",\n          title=f\"Announcements · {settings.SITE_TITLE}\", root=\"\", posts=published)\n    for post in published:\n        write(f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\", \"public/post.html\", root=\"../\", post=post,\n              title=post[\"title\"])\n    return out\n","numLines":113,"startLine":1,"totalLines":113}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8aaff01f-7488-4c3b-9fe6-4d54cd8f8566","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"9e5daa94-ee9d-476c-a5f4-c1dfd7e39574","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"97d44139-d923-463e-bf29-4be532d1729f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01C8DrU1oZxnX7P5tXdUomeC","type":"tool_result","content":"=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\nbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\nfrom app.publish import WELCOME\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, posts, users\nfrom app.web import render, templates\n\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n\n\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Template rendering for the admin console.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import permissions, security, settings\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n# Templates use this only to hide controls; the server still checks every request.\ntemplates.env.globals[\"can\"] = permissions.allowed\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef route(context, name: str, **params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of a named route, e.g. route('edit_post', post_id=3).\n\n    Templates use this instead of writing \"/admin/...\" by hand, so a link or\n    form action follows its route if the route's path ever changes.\n    \"\"\"\n    return context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **params)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"route\"] = route\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    \"\"\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\"\"\"\n    context.setdefault(\"title\", \"Admin\")\n    context[\"csrf_token\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\n    context[\"home_path\"] = request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\n=== app/routes/admin.py\n\"\"\"The admin console. Everything under /admin is guarded by security.AdminGuard.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Request\n\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", title=\"Dashboard\",\n                  user=request.state.user)\n=== app/routes/__init__.py\n=== app/rendering.py\n\"\"\"Markdown Body -> safe HTML. The one path for the public export and, later, Preview.\n\nRaw HTML is let through the Markdown parser and then removed by the sanitizer,\nso `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<form>` and event handlers never survive. Only\nheadings, emphasis, lists, links and images (with alt text) are kept.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\nimport nh3\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True})\n\n_TAGS = {\n    \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"p\", \"br\", \"em\", \"strong\",\n    \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"a\", \"img\",\n}\n_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\", \"title\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\", \"title\"}}\n_URL_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n\n\ndef _keep_attribute(_tag: str, name: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Drop root-absolute links and images: the site is served from a subfolder.\"\"\"\n    if name in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip().startswith(\"/\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\ndef render_body(markdown: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(\n        _markdown.render(markdown),\n        tags=_TAGS,\n        attributes=_ATTRIBUTES,\n        url_schemes=_URL_SCHEMES,\n        clean_content_tags={\"script\", \"style\", \"iframe\", \"form\"},\n        attribute_filter=_keep_attribute,\n    )\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nDATABASE_PATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"African Student Association\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n=== scripts/seed_demo.py\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates the demo Admin (\"admin\") and Editor (\"editor\") if they do not exist, with\npasswords from CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD. As you build content\ntypes, extend this so it also creates:\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import closing\n\nfrom app import accounts, posts, settings\nfrom app.db import connect\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    accounts.seed_demo_accounts(\n        settings.DATABASE_PATH, admin_password=admin_pw, editor_password=editor_pw)\n    seed_demo_posts(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    print(\"Demo accounts ready: 'admin' and 'editor' (passwords from your environment). \"\n          \"Demo Posts ready: one Published, one Draft.\")\n    return 0\n\n\n# Placeholders only: no claim about ASA's real events, dates, places or people.\nDEMO_POSTS = [\n    (\"Afrobeat event (demo placeholder)\", True,\n     \"This is a **demo placeholder**, not a real ASA announcement.\\n\\n\"\n     \"- **What:** an Afrobeat event\\n- **When:** to be announced\\n\"\n     \"- **Where:** to be announced\\n- **Who can attend:** to be announced\\n\"),\n    (\"Draft idea (demo placeholder)\", False,\n     \"A draft that must never appear on the public site.\\n\"),\n]\n\n\ndef seed_demo_posts(path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the demo Posts once, written by the demo Editor.\"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts\").fetchone():\n            return\n        editor = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'editor'\").fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    for title, published, body in DEMO_POSTS:\n        post_id = posts.create(path, title=title, body=body, author_id=editor)\n        if published:\n            posts.publish(path, post_id)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n=== templates/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header><a href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a></header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== templates/admin/post_form.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ route('post_list') }}\">All Posts</a></p>\n  <h1>{% if post %}Edit Post{% else %}New Post{% endif %}</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{% if post %}{{ route('save_post', post_id=post.id) }}{% else %}{{ route('create_post') }}{% endif %}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <p><label>Title <input name=\"title\" value=\"{{ title_value }}\" required></label></p>\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br>\n      <textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"14\" cols=\"60\">{{ body_value }}</textarea></label></p>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">{% if post %}Save changes{% else %}Save as Draft{% endif %}</button></p>\n  </form>\n\n  {% if post %}\n  <dl>\n    <dt>Status</dt><dd><strong id=\"post-status\">{{ post.status | capitalize }}</strong></dd>\n    <dt>Author</dt><dd>{{ post.author_name }}</dd>\n    <dt>Slug</dt><dd><code id=\"post-slug\">{{ post.slug }}</code></dd>\n    <dt>Created</dt><dd><time id=\"created\" datetime=\"{{ post.created_at }}\">{{ post.created_at[:16] | replace('T', ' ') }} UTC</time></dd>\n    <dt>Updated</dt><dd><time id=\"updated\" datetime=\"{{ post.updated_at }}\">{{ post.updated_at[:16] | replace('T', ' ') }} UTC</time></dd>\n    <dt>First published</dt>\n    <dd>{% if post.first_published_at %}<time id=\"first-published\" datetime=\"{{ post.first_published_at }}\">{{ post.first_published_at[:16] | replace('T', ' ') }} UTC</time>{% else %}Not yet published{% endif %}</dd>\n  </dl>\n\n  {% if post.status == 'draft' %}\n  {% if can(user.role, 'post.publish') %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ route('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Mark Published</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif can(user.role, 'post.unpublish') %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ route('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Unpublish</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  {% if can(user.role, 'post.change_slug') %}\n  <h2 id=\"slug\">Change the slug</h2>\n  <p role=\"note\">Changing the slug can break an old link that someone has already shared.</p>\n  {% if slug_error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ slug_error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ route('change_slug', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <p><label>Slug <input name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ post.slug }}\" required></label></p>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">Change slug</button></p>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  {% if can(user.role, 'post.delete') %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ route('delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Delete this Post</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/admin/post_list.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ route('dashboard') }}\">Dashboard</a></p>\n  <h1>Posts</h1>\n  {% if can(user.role, 'post.create') %}<p><a href=\"{{ route('new_post') }}\">Write a new Post</a></p>{% endif %}\n  {% if posts %}\n  <ul>\n    {% for post in posts %}\n    <li>\n      <a href=\"{{ route('edit_post', post_id=post.id) app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\nbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\nfrom app.publish import WELCOME\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, posts, users\nfrom app.web import render, templates\n\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n\n\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Template rendering for the admin console.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import permissions, security, settings\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n# Templates use this only to hide controls; the server still checks every request.\ntemplates.env.globals[\"can\"] = permissions.allowed\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef route(context, name: str, **params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of a named route, e.g. route('edit_post', post_id=3).\n\n    Templates use this instead of writing \"/admin/...\" by hand, so a link or\n    form action follows its route if the route's path ever changes.\n    \"\"\"\n    return context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **params)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"route\"] = route\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    \"\"\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\"\"\"\n    context.setdefault(\"title\", \"Admin\")\n    context[\"csrf_token\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\n    context[\"home_path\"] = request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\n=== app/routes/admin.py\n\"\"\"The admin console. Everything under /admin is guarded by security.AdminGuard.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Request\n\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", title=\"Dashboard\",\n                  user=request.state.user)\n=== app/routes/__init__.py\n=== app/rendering.py\n\"\"\"Markdown Body -> safe HTML. The one path for the public export and, later, Preview.\n\nRaw HTML is let through the Markdown parser and then removed by the sanitizer,\nso `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<form>` and event handlers never survive. Only\nheadings, emphasis, lists, links and images (with alt text) are kept.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\nimport nh3\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True})\n\n_TAGS = {\n    \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"p\", \"br\", \"em\", \"strong\",\n    \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"a\", \"img\",\n}\n_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\", \"title\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\", \"title\"}}\n_URL_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n\n\ndef _keep_attribute(_tag: str, name: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Drop root-absolute links and images: the site is served from a subfolder.\"\"\"\n    if name in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip().startswith(\"/\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\ndef render_body(markdown: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(\n        _markdown.render(markdown),\n        tags=_TAGS,\n        attributes=_ATTRIBUTES,\n        url_schemes=_URL_SCHEMES,\n        clean_content_tags={\"script\", \"style\", \"iframe\", \"form\"},\n        attribute_filter=_keep_attribute,\n    )\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nDATABASE_PATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD. As you build content\ntypes, extend this so it also creates:\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import closing\n\nfrom app import accounts, posts, settings\nfrom app.db import connect\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    accounts.seed_demo_accounts(\n        settings.DATABASE_PATH, admin_password=admin_pw, editor_password=editor_pw)\n    seed_demo_posts(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    print(\"Demo accounts ready: 'admin' and 'editor' (passwords from your environment). \"\n          \"Demo Posts ready: one Published, one Draft.\")\n    return 0\n\n\n# Placeholders only: no claim about ASA's real events, dates, places or people.\nDEMO_POSTS = [\n    (\"Afrobeat event (demo placeholder)\", True,\n     \"This is a **demo placeholder**, not a real ASA announcement.\\n\\n\"\n     \"- **What:** an Afrobeat event\\n- **When:** to be announced\\n\"\n     \"- **Where:** to be announced\\n- **Who can attend:** to be announced\\n\"),\n    (\"Draft idea (demo placeholder)\", False,\n     \"A draft that must never appear on the public site.\\n\"),\n]\n\n\ndef seed_demo_posts(path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the demo Posts once, written by the demo Editor.\"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts\").fetchone():\n            return\n        editor = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'editor'\").fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    for title, published, body in DEMO_POSTS:\n        post_id = posts.create(path, title=title, body=body, author_id=editor)\n        if published:\n            posts.publish(path, post_id)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n=== templates/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, {"parentUuid":"9aa1d7e7-7dc4-4c70-b5c5-fee6730cd0e9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"97d44139-d923-463e-bf29-4be532d1729f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JStSYXXPjryHY7qVCEnVP3","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T03: Published Posts go Live on the public site.\n\nSeam 2 (the published site on disk): seed Posts, call the publish step into a\ntemporary folder, and read the HTML files it wrote. Nothing here looks at\ninternal functions or templates.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import accounts, posts\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\nWELCOME = \"primarily for African students and students with African backgrounds\"\n\n\ndef author_id(db_path, username=\"editor\"):\n    with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?\",\n                            (username,)).fetchone()[0]\n\n\ndef add_post(db_path, title, body=\"What: music\", *, published=True, by=\"editor\"):\n    post_id = posts.create(db_path, title=title, body=body,\n                           author_id=author_id(db_path, by))\n    if published:\n        posts.publish(db_path, post_id)\n    return post_id\n\n\ndef site_files(out):\n    return sorted(p for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.is_file())\n\n\ndef all_text(out):\n    return \"\\n\".join(p.read_text() for p in site_files(out)\n                     if p.suffix in (\".html\", \".css\"))\n\n\ndef html_files(out):\n    return [p for p in site_files(out) if p.suffix == \".html\"]\n\n\ndef read(out, name):\n    return (out / name).read_text()\n\n\ndef titles_in_order(html):\n    \"\"\"The Event card titles in the order they appear on the page.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r'<h2 class=\"card-title\"><a [^>]*>([^<]+)</a>', html)\n\n\ndef publish(db_path, tmp_path):\n    return render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", database=db_path)\n\n\n# -- what is written ---------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_publish_writes_home_announcements_and_one_page_per_post(db_path, tmp_path):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Movie Evening\")\n    out = publish(db_path, tmp_path)\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"announcements.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n    assert \"Afrobeat Night\" in read(out, \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\")\n    assert \"Movie Evening\" in read(out, \"posts/movie-evening.html\")\n\n\ndef test_home_page_has_the_welcome_text(db_path, tmp_path):\n    out = publish(db_path, tmp_path)\n    assert WELCOME in read(out, \"index.html\")\n\n\ndef test_home_shows_the_five_latest_and_links_to_all_announcements(db_path, tmp_path):\n    for n in range(1, 8):\n        add_post(db_path, f\"Post number {n}\")\n    out = publish(db_path, tmp_path)\n    home = read(out, \"index.html\")\n    assert titles_in_order(home) == [f\"Post number {n}\" for n in (7, 6, 5, 4, 3)]\n    assert 'href=\"announcements.html\"' in home\n    assert len(titles_in_order(read(out, \"announcements.html\"))) == 7\n\n\n# -- Drafts never leave the database ---------------------------------------\n\ndef test_a_draft_appears_nowhere_in_the_export(db_path, tmp_path):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Secret Plans Draft\", \"Hidden body text zebra\", published=False)\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    out = publish(db_path, tmp_path)\n    text = all_text(out)\n    for needle in (\"Secret Plans\", \"secret-plans\", \"Hidden body\", \"zebra\"):\n        assert needle not in text\n    assert not (out / \"posts\" / \"secret-plans-draft.html\").exists()\n    assert not any(\"secret-plans\" in p.name for p in site_files(out))\n\n\ndef test_an_unpublished_post_disappears_on_the_next_publish(db_path, tmp_path):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Wrong Announcement\", \"wrong details\")\n    assert (publish(db_path, tmp_path) / \"posts/wrong-announcement.html\").exists()\n    posts.unpublish(db_path, post_id)\n    out = publish(db_path, tmp_path)\n    assert \"Wrong Announcement\" not in only,\nrelative paths, and no Draft Page anywhere in the export.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import pages\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token, token_in\nfrom \"/admin/pages/new\"\n\n\ndef is_refusal(response):\n    return response.status_code == 403 and REFUSAL in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef post_to(client, path, **data):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = re.search(r'id=\"page-slug\"[^>]*>([^<]+)<', html).group(1).strip()\n\n\ndef add_page(db_path, title, slug=None, body=\"Placeholder body\", *, published=True):\n    slug = slug or     pages.publish(db_path, page_id)\n    return page_id\n\n\ndef nav(html):\n    \"\"\"The Navigation as [(label, href)] in the order shown.\"\"\"\n    block = re.search(r'<nav aria-label=\"Main\">(.*?)</nav>', html, re.S).group(1)\n    return re.findall(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>', block)[::1] and [\n        (label.strip(), href) for href, label in\n        re.findall(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>', block)]\n\n\n# == Seam 1: the admin console =================================================\n\n# -- the Admin manages Pages     pages.publish(db_path, page_id)\n    return page_id\n\n\ndef nav(html):\n    \"\"\"The Navigation as [(label, href)] in the order shown.\"\"\"\n    block = re.search(r'<nav aria-label=\"Main\">(.*?)</nav>', html, re.S).group(1)\n    return re.findall(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>', block)[::1] and [\n        (label.strip(), href) for href, label in\n        re.findall(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>', block)]\n\n\n# == Seam 1: the admin console =================================================\n\n# -- the Admin manages Pages     pages.publish(db_path, page_id)\n    return page_id\n\n\ndef nav(html):\n    \"\"\"The Navigation as [(label, href)] in the order shown.\"\"\"\n    block = re.search(r'<nav {"parentUuid":"9a71e4a5-7ab2-4cce-a324-9386134cc3ce","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfwiVMUBaAysodJSVW18S","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GiV8SBqUTpfJU8vKmEAe5M","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/pages.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages: permanent content that appears in the public Navigation once Published.\n\nNothing here knows about HTTP. Unlike a Post, a Page's slug is entered by the\nAdmin, and each Page is written to the site root as `<slug>.html`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app.db import connect\nfrom app.posts import PostError, SlugInvalid, SlugTaken, _now, slugify\n\n\nclass PageError(PostError):\n    \"\"\"A request about a Page that cannot be honoured (shown to the person).\"\"\"\n\n\nclass PageTitleRequired(PageError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass PageSlugInvalid(PageError, SlugInvalid):\n    pass\n\n\nclass PageSlugTaken(PageError, SlugTaken):\n    pass\n\n\n# Files the export already writes at the site root; a Page may not overwrite them.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = frozenset({\"index\", \"announcements\"})\n\n_WITH_AUTHOR = (\"SELECT pages.*, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n                \"FROM pages LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = pages.author_id\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise PageTitleRequired(\"A Page needs a title.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef _clean_slug(slug: str) -> str:\n    slug = slugify(slug)\n    if not slug:\n        raise PageSlugInvalid(\"A slug needs at least one letter or number.\")\n    if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise PageSlugInvalid(f\"'{slug}' is used by the site itself. Choose another slug.\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create(path: Path, *, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n           author_id: int | None = None) -> int:\n    title, slug = _clean_title(title), _clean_slug(slug)\n    now = _now()\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO pages (title, slug, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\", (title, slug, body, author_id, now, now))\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise PageSlugTaken(f\"Another Page already uses '{slug}'.\") from None\n\n\ndef get(path: Path, page_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_WITH_AUTHOR} WHERE pages.id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef list_all(path: Path) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_WITH_AUTHOR} ORDER BY pages.id\").fetchall()\n\n\ndef list_published(path: Path) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages only, in the order they were created: the Navigation order.\"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT title, slug, body FROM pages \"\n                            \"WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY id\").fetchall()\n\n\ndef update_body(path: Path, page_id: int, body: str) -> None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE pages SET body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (body, _now(), page_id))\n\n\ndef retitle(path: Path, page_id: int, title: str) -> None:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE pages SET title = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (title, _now(), page_id))\n\n\ndef change_slug(path: Path, page_id: int, slug: str) -> None:\n    slug = _clean_slug(slug)\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            conn.execute(\"UPDATE pages SET slug = ?, updated_at = ? Templates ask\n`can(role, action)` only to hide controls; hiding is never the protection.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\nEVERYONE = frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR})\nADMIN_ONLY = frozenset({ADMIN})\n\nRULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"post.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.create\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.edit\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.publish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.list\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.view\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.change_role\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.deactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.reactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.reset_password\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.change_display_name\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n}\n\n\nclass PermissionRefused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The signed-in account's role may not do this action.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef allowed(role: str, action: str) -> bool:\n    # An action missing from the table is refused, never allowed by accident.\n    return role in RULES.get(action, frozenset())\n\n\ndef require(action: str):\n    \"\"\"A route dependency: refuse the request unless the role may `action`.\n\n    Runs before the route looks anything up, so an Editor gets the same\n    refusal whether or not the thing they asked about exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if action not in RULES:\n        raise KeyError(f\"unknown action: {action}\")\n\n    def check(request: Request) -> None:\n        if not allowed(request.state.user[\"role\"], action):\n            raise PermissionRefused(action)\n\n    return check\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":6,"newStart":20,"newLines":14,"lines":["     \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,","     \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,","     \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"page.list\": EVERYONE,","+    \"page.edit_body\": EVERYONE,","+    \"page.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"page.retitle\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"page.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"page.publish\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"page.unpublish\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"page.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,","     \"user.list\": ADMIN_ONLY,","     \"user.view\": ADMIN_ONLY,","     \"user.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b722989d-a62e-4689-afb8-dddd2c615312","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}

         title=\"Edit Page\", user=request.state.user, page=page, **context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.list\"))])\ndef page_list(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_list.html\", title=\"Pages\",\n                  user=request.state.user, pages=pages.list_all(_db(request)))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.create\"))])\ndef new_page(request: Request):\n    return _new_form(request, title_value=\"\", slug_value=\"\", body_value=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.create\"))])\ndef create_page(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n                body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    try:\n        page_id = pages.create(_db(request), title=title, slug=slug, body=body,\n                               author_id=request.state.user[\"id\"])\n    except pages.PageError as error:\n        code = 409 if isinstance(error, pages.PageSlugTaken) else 400\n        return _new_form(request, status_code=code, error=str(error),\n                         title_value=title, slug_value=slug, body_value=body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.edit_body\"))])\ndef edit_page(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    return _edit_form(request, _found(request, page_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.edit_body\"))])\ndef save_page_body(request: Request, page_id: int, body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    _found(request, page_id)\n    pages.update_body(_db(request), page_id, body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/title\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.retitle\"))])\ndef retitle_page(request: Request, page_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\")):\n    page = _found(request, page_id)\n    try:\n        pages.retitle(_db(request), page_id, title)\n    except pages.PageError as error:\n        return _edit_form(request, page, status_code=400, title_error=str(error))\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/slug\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.change_slug\"))])\ndef change_page_slug(request: Request, page_id: int, slug: str = Form(\"\")):\n    page = _found(request, page_id)\n    try:\n        pages.change_slug(_db(request), page_id, slug)\n    except pages.PageError as error:\n        code = 409 if isinstance(error, pages.PageSlugTaken) else 400\n        return _edit_form(request, page, status_code=code, slug_error=str(error))\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/publish\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.publish\"))])\ndef publish_page(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    _found(request, page_id)\n    pages.publish(_db(request), page_id)\n    return status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.delete\"))])\ndef delete_page(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    _found(request, page_id)\n Permission is checked before the Page\nis looked up. The Body route reads only `body`: anything else in the submission\nis ignored.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import pages\nfrom app.permissions import require\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\")\n\n\ndef _db(request: Request):\n    return request.app.state.database\n\n\ndef _edit_url(request: Request, page_id: int) -> str:\n    return request.app.url_path_for(\"edit_page\", page_id=page_id)\n\n\ndef _found(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    page = pages.get(_db(request), page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Page.\")\n    return page\n\n\ndef _new_form(request: Request, *, status_code=200, **context):\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_new.html\", status_code=status_code,\n                  title=\"New Page\", user=request.state.user, **context)\n\n\ndef _edit_form(request: Request, page, *, status_code=200, **context):\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_form.html\", status_code=status_code,\n                  title=\"Edit Page\", user=request.state.user, page=page, **context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.list\"))])\ndef page_list(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_list.html\", title=\"Pages\",\n                  user=request.state.user, pages=pages.list_all(_db(request)))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.create\"))])\ndef new_page(request: Request):\n    return _new_form(request, title_value=\"\", slug_value=\"\", body_value=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.create\"))])\ndef create_page(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n                body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    try:\n        page_id = pages.create(_db(request), title=title, slug=slug, body=body,\n                               author_id=request.state.user[\"id\"])\n    except pages.PageError as error:\n        code = 409 if isinstance(error, pages.PageSlugTaken) else 400\n        return _new_form(request, status_code=code, error=str(error),\n                         title_value=title, slug_value=slug, body_value=body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.edit_body\"))])\ndef edit_page(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    return _edit_form(request, _found(request, page_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.edit_body\"))])\ndef save_page_body(request: Request, page_id: int, body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    _found(request, page_id)\n    pages.update_body(_db(request), page_id, body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/title\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.retitle\"))])\ndef retitle_page(request: Request, page_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\")):\n    page = _found(request, page_id)\n    try:\n        pages.retitle(_db(request), page_id, title)\n    except pages.PageError as error:\n        return _edit_form(request, page, status_code=400, title_error=str(error))\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/slug\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.change_slug\"))])\ndef change_page_slug(request: Request, page_id: int, slug: str = Form(\"\")):\n    page = _found(request, page_id)\n    try:\n        pages.change_slug(_db(request), page_id, slug)\n    except pages.PageError as error:\n        code = 409 if isinstance(error, pages.PageSlugTaken) else 400\n        return _edit_form(request, page, status_code=code, slug_error=str(error))\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/publish\", RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, page_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/unpublish\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.unpublish\"))])\ndef unpublish_page(request: Request, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"page.delete\"))])\ndef delete_page(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    _found(request, page_id)\n Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\nfrom app.publish import WELCOME\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, posts, users\nfrom app.web import render, templates\n\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n\n\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n        )\n\n    # The byline is the Author's Display name; the Username is not\n    even selected.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(database)) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT posts.author_id \"\n            \"WHERE posts.status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY posts.first_published_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    return [_post_for_template(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef _post_for_template(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:\n    posted_iso, posted_label = _day(row[\"first_published_at\"])\n    post = {\n        \"title\": row[\"title\"], \"slug\": row[\"slug\"], \"author_name\": row[\"author_name\"],\n        \"body_html\": render_body(row[\"body\"]),\n        \"posted_iso\": posted_iso, \"posted_label\": posted_label,\n        \"updated_iso\": None, \"updated_label\": None,\n    }\n    if row[\"updated_at\"] > row[\"first_published_at\"]:\n        post[\"updated_iso\"], post[\"updated_label\"] = _day(row[\"updated_at\"])\n    return post\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    if out.exists():\n (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"d0a9227b-c1f9-4648-9977-6c23d82c9945","timestamp":"2026-10-12T04:32:21.891Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/publish.py","oldString":"from app import settings\nfrom app.db import connect","newString":"from app import pages, settings\nfrom app.db import connect","originalFile":"\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nTwo rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     Pages one folder down (posts/) reach the site root with a `root` of \"../\".\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.db import connect\nfrom app.rendering import render_body\n\n# The wording comes from notes/client-brief.md. Make no other claim about ASA.\nWELCOME = (\n    \"ASA is a Kenyon student group primarily for African students and students \"\n    \"with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African \"\n    \"cultures and community.\"\n)\nHOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS = 5\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\na:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\nimg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }\n.card { border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; margin-block: 1rem; }\n.card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }\n.meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9rem; opacity: 0.8; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _day(timestamp: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A stored UTC timestamp as (\"2026-09-28\", \"28 September 2026\").\"\"\"\n    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)\n    return moment.date().isoformat(), f\"{moment.day} {moment:%B %Y}\"\n\n\ndef _published_posts(database: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Published Posts only, newest First-published date first.\n\n    Ordered by First-published date, not by edit time, so a correction never\n    moves a Post. The byline is the Author's Display name; the Username is not\n    even selected.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(database)) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT posts.title, posts.slug, posts.body, posts.updated_at, \"\n            \"posts.first_published_at, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n            \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id \"\n            \"WHERE posts.status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY posts.first_published_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    return [_post_for_template(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef _post_for_template(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:\n    posted_iso, posted_label = _day(row[\"first_published_at\"])\n    post = {\n        \"title\": row[\"title\"], \"slug\": row[\"slug\"], \"author_name\": row[\"author_name\"],\n        \"body_html\": render_body(row[\"body\"]),\n        \"posted_iso\": posted_iso, \"posted_label\": posted_label,\n        \"updated_iso\": None, \"updated_label\": None,\n    }\n    if row[\"updated_at\"] > row[\"first_published_at\"]:\n        post[\"updated_iso\"], post[\"updated_label\"] = _day(row[\"updated_at\"])\n    return post\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    published = _published_posts(database)\n    published_pages = pages.list_published(database)\n    # Every page of the site shows the same Navigation; the template prefixes `root`.\n    common = {\"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"nav_pages\": published_pages}\n\n    def write(name: str, template: str, **context) -> None:\n        (out / name).write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n            **common, **context))\n\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    write(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=\"\",\n          welcome=WELCOME, posts=published[:HOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS])\n    write(\"announcements.html\", \"public/announcements.html\",\n          title=f\"Announcements · {settings.SITE_TITLE}\", root=\"\", posts=published)\n    for post in published:\n        write(f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\", \"public/post.html\", root=\"../\", post=post,\n              title=post[\"title\"])\n    for page in published_pages:\n        write(f\"{page['slug']}.html\", \"public/page.html\", root=\"\", title=page[\"title\"],\n              page={\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"body_html\": render_body(page[\"body\"])})\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":7,"newStart":17,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape"," ","-from app import settings","+from app import pages, settings"," from app.db import connect"," from app.rendering import render_body"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a9d1cf5d-f1f6-43f7-8f70-8af8e6e950fc","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"da6b82d3-203f-40aa-9d1d-ac119d9a943f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"97d44139-d923-463e-bf29-4be532d1729f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yawoppong-krampah/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: since HEAD (uncommitted work for ticket #6, spec #1)"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"e00f6d08-49e2-4762-977b-7d80da650737","timestamp":"2026-10-12T04:33:41.029Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01UJZ6mcJMa9JcsvPDixAw5f","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>**Review of T05 (Pages) against #6 and spec #1**\n\n**(a) Missing or partial**\n- None of the nine acceptance criteria is missing. One is thin:\n  - Spec: \"Only the Admin can change any slug, and the form warns that this can break existing links.\"\n  - The warning is a static note printed above the slug form, the same as for Posts, so it meets \"same warning as Posts\". It is not shown at the moment of the change, and there is no confirmation step.\n- Spec, story 36: \"see title, slug, status and delete controls as unavailable\". The Editor screen shows title, status and slug as read-only text and hides the controls. That fits \"hidden\", but the slug is visible to Editors. Spec: \"Slug edits are not shown to Editors\". This is minor and arguably fine.\n- Preview (\"The editor's view of a Post or Page\") does not exist for Posts either, so it is correctly not in this ticket.\n\n**(b) Scope creep**\n- `RESERVED_SLUGS` (`index`, `announcements`) and the new `PageSlugInvalid` error type. They are not in the ticket. They are justified to stop a Page overwriting `index.html`, but they are an unrequested rule.\n- `pages.author_id` and the `LEFT JOIN users ... author_name` in `list_all`. Spec: \"the Author is optional for display\". No template uses `author_name`, so the join is unused.\n- An extra seed Page, \"Get involved (draft)\". Spec: \"published and draft Pages\", so it is defensible. The ticket names only the three starter Pages.\n- A dashboard link to Pages. Small, and needed for navigation.\n\n**(c) Implemented but possibly wrong**\n- **Slug silently rewritten.** `_clean_slug` runs `slugify()` on the Admin's input. Spec: \"A Page's slug is entered by the Admin\". Typing `About_ASA` saves `about-asa` with no message, and the form does not echo the stored value on create. Rejecting bad input or showing the result would be clearer.\n- **Slug collisions are only partly covered.** `index` and `announcements` are blocked.\n  - `posts` is safe: `posts.html` sits beside the `posts/` directory.\n  - `style` is safe: `style.html` does not clash with `style.css`.\n  - The reserved list is hand-maintained and separate from the filenames `render_site` writes. A future root file such as `404` or `sitemap` would silently be overwritten. Deriving the list from the renderer would be safer.\n  - Retitling is not affected, since only slugs map to filenames.\n- **Navigation paths.** Spec: \"only relative paths\". `base.html` prefixes `root`, and Pages are written at the site root with `root=\"\"`. Post pages use `../`, so this is correct.\n- **Editor extra fields.** `save_page_body` takes only `body`. The Admin routes check permission before looking up the Page, so a nonexistent id is still refused for an Editor. This is correct.\n- **Status changes do not touch `updated_at`.** `publish` and `unpublish` leave it alone. Nothing in the spec requires it, but it is inconsistent with `retitle` and `change_slug`.\n- **Stale links after a slug change.** The old URL disappears on the next publish with no redirect. This is accepted by the spec's \"warned\" wording.\n- **Navigation order.** It is by `id` (creation order), not alphabetical or configurable. The spec does not say. A deleted and recreated Page moves to the end of the Navigation.\n\nI only read the code and tests. I did not run the test suite.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>58127</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>6</tool_uses><duration_ms>31299</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>**Review of T05 (Pages in the Navigation): no hard violations found.** The full suite passes (240 tests). I made no edits.\n\n## (a) Hard constraints and standards\n\n- **Relative paths:** `templates/public/base.html` and `page.html` build every link from `{{ root }}`. `render_site` passes `root=\"\"` for root-level Pages. The Page export test asserts no `href` or `src` starts with `/`, including for a Page body containing `[admin](/admin)`.\n- **CSRF:** all 6 new POST forms in `page_form.html` and `page_new.html` carry `csrf_token`. The tests also replay each POST without a token.\n- **Sanitized Markdown:** `publish.py` renders Page bodies through `render_body`, the same path Posts use. The Page title is autoescaped.\n- **Drafts:** `list_published` filters on `status = 'published'`. Tests check that a Draft Page, an unpublished Page and a deleted Page never reach `site/`.\n- **Access control (SECURITY-CHECKLIST #4 and #10):** every route uses `Depends(require(\"page.*\"))`, and `permissions.py` has one rule per action. The Editor can edit the body only. `save_page_body` reads only `body`.\n- **CONTEXT.md vocabulary:** the diff uses Page, Slug, Navigation, Body, Published and \"Mark Published\". Nothing it uses is on an \"Avoid\" list.\n- **ADRs:** no new dependency, and the stack is unchanged.\n\n## (b) Smells (judgement calls only)\n\n1. **Duplicated Code.**\n   - `app/pages.py` repeats `posts.py` in several places: the `PageError`/`PageTitleRequired`/`PageSlugInvalid`/`PageSlugTaken` hierarchy, `_clean_title`, `_WITH_AUTHOR`, and `publish`/`unpublish`/`delete`.\n   - The slug-conflict `try/except sqlite3.IntegrityError` is repeated within `create` and `change_slug`.\n   - `routes/pages.py` repeats `_db`, `_edit_url`, `_found`, and the publish/unpublish/delete handlers from `routes/posts.py`.\n   - `page_form.html` copies the slug-warning, publish and delete blocks from `post_form.html`.\n   - Extracting a shared helper is optional. Two copies is borderline.\n2. **Repeated Switches.** `code = 409 if isinstance(error, pages.PageSlugTaken) else 400` appears twice in `routes/pages.py` (`create_page`, `change_page_slug`). It also appears in `routes/posts.py`. A `status_code` attribute on the exception would remove all three.\n3. **Feature Envy / hidden coupling.** `from app.posts import _now, slugify` imports a private helper across modules. Moving `_now` and `slugify` somewhere shared would fix it.\n4. **Data Clumps.** `title`, `slug` and `body` travel together through `pages.create`, `_new_form`, and `title_value`/`slug_value`/`body_value`. This is mild and arguably fine at this size.\n5. **Speculative Generality.**\n   - `create(..., author_id: int | None = None)` plus the nullable `pages.author_id` and `LEFT JOIN` are looser than the Post equivalents, which require an Author. Every caller passes an author.\n   - `list_all` selects `author_name`, but no template uses it.\n6. **Mysterious Name / inconsistency.**\n   - `list_published` returns rows with `body`, and the full set goes into `nav_pages` for every page, though the nav needs only `title` and `slug`.\n   - `render_site` builds the Page template dict inline, while Posts use `_post_for_template`. The two styles differ.\n   - `common` is a vague name for what it holds. This is minor.\n7. **Divergent Change (weak).** `render_site` now handles Posts, Navigation and Pages. It is still small.\n\n## Spec note (not a standard)\n\nCONTEXT.md says the Content list rows show Display name and last-updated time. `page_list.html` shows only title and status. This may belong to a later ticket. The Dashboard also still has no four-count display.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>67706</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>7</tool_uses><duration_ms>55939</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

{"parentUuid":"f75ce4f5-405d-49d2-9448-62ddb89f65f4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfwinGjAPdXpuTB9bBfmp","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GwqMvoanK2k11jwUuZa5Y9","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yawoppong-krampah-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa/scratchpad/review.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review for T05 (two axes, working tree vs `e0df28a`)\n\nFull suite: 240 passed (181 before, 59 new in `tests/test_t05_pages.py`). A mutation check (opening `page.delete` and `page.retitle` to Editors) made 6 permission tests fail, so they do exercise the rule table.\n\n### Standards: no hard violations\nRelative paths, CSRF on all 6 new forms (and each POST replayed without a token), sanitized Body via `render_body`, no Drafts in `site/`, `require(\"page.*\")` on every route, CONTEXT.md vocabulary, no new dependency.\n\nJudgement-call smells, and what I did:\n- **Navigation carried every Page's full Body into every template** (`list_published` rows passed as `nav_pages`). **Fixed:** `render_site` now passes only `title` and `slug`.\n- **Duplicated Code** between `pages.py`/`routes/pages.py`/`page_form.html` and their Post equivalents (error classes, `_found`, publish/unpublish/delete handlers, slug warning). **Left:** two copies; extracting a shared helper is a refactor of working T02 code and not part of this ticket.\n- **Repeated Switches**: `409 if SlugTaken else 400` (also already in `routes/posts.py`). **Left**, same reason.\n- **Private helper imported across modules** (`from app.posts import _now, slugify`). **Left** for now; worth moving to a shared module when a third caller appears.\n- **Speculative Generality**: nullable `pages.author_id` and the `author_name` join in `list_all` are unused by any template today. **Left on purpose:** the spec says a Page's Author is \"optional for display\" and T06's Content list needs a Display name per row.\n- **Content list columns (Display name, last-updated)** are not on the Pages list. **Deferred to T06** (#7), which owns the Content list.\n\n### Spec: all 9 acceptance criteria met, none missing\nFindings and resolutions:\n- **Slug is tidied silently** (`About_ASA` saves as `about-asa`). **Left:** same behaviour as Post slug changes; the edit page shows the stored slug.\n- **Reserved slugs** (`index`, `announcements`) are a hand-kept list beside what `render_site` writes. **Left**, with the rule documented in `app/pages.py`. Without it a Page could overwrite `index.html`. A future root-level file means adding it there.\n- **`updated_at` does not move on publish/unpublish** (it does on Body/title/slug changes). **Left:** the spec ties the Updated date to content changes only.\n- **Navigation order is creation order** (id), not configurable. **Left:** the spec gives no ordering rule; Without it a Page could overwrite `index.html`. A future root-level file means adding it there.\n- **`updated_at` does not move on publish/unpublish** (it does on Body/title/slug changes). **Left:** the spec ties the Updated date to content changes only.\n- **Navigation order is creation order** (id), not configurable. **Left:** the spec gives no ordering rule; the demo seeds About ASA, Resources, Photos in that order.\n- **Editor sees the slug as read-only text.** **Left:** story 36 asks for controls to be unavailable, not hidden facts; no input or form action for it is rendered to an Editor.\n- Extra seeded Draft Page (\"Get involved (draft)\") and a Pages link on the Dashboard are small additions the spec's \"published and draft Pages\" demo data and navigation need.\nEOF\ngh issue comment 6 --body-file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yawoppong-krampah-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa/scratchpad/review.md","description":"Post code-review findings on issue 6"}},"wireIngestContext":{"toolu_01GwqMvoanK2k11jwUuZa5Y9":{"cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms"}},"apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011CfwinGPKSgD2yW8MWA7Zj","type":"assistant","uuid":"6e5cb1b5-b988-4f02-b008-83deb5ca4958","timestamp":"2026-10-12T04:35:35.956Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"18b6f61c-acfb-481e-bba7-896a5d2333aa","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"6dccffdb-9d80-40ee-8248-52791bf20eab","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfwiohBbkh2rkBMafY9MP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 is committed as `eb55f6a`, with `Closes #6` in the message. The full suite passes at 240 tests (181 before, 59 new). The commit isn't pushed, so the issue stays open until it lands on the remote. I haven't run the app by hand or run `cms publish`; everything is verified through the tests.\n\n- **Admin:** an Admin can create a Page, edit its Body, retitle it, change its slug, publish, unpublish and delete it. Changing a slug shows the same broken-link warning as for Posts.\n- **Editor:** an Editor can edit only the Body. Every other Page action is refused with the \"You don't have permission\" page, including by direct submission, and those controls are hidden on their screens.\n- **Public site:** each Published Page is written to the site root and listed in the Navigation after Announcements, with relative paths only. Draft, unpublished and deleted Pages never reach `site/`. Page Bodies go through the same Markdown sanitizing as Posts.\n- **Seed:** the demo seed adds About ASA, Resources and Photos as labelled placeholders, plus one Draft Page. The Photos page says actual event photos will be added when ASA has permission.\n- **Permission tests:** I temporarily opened `page.delete` and `page.retitle` to Editors. Six of the new tests failed, so the permission tests do catch a loosened rule. I then restored the rules.\n\n**`/code-review`:**\n- **Standards:** no hard violations.\n- **Spec:** all nine acceptance criteria met.\n- **Fixed:** the Navigation was passing every Page's full Body into each template. It now passes only the title and slug.\n- **Left on purpose:** the code duplicated from Posts (the Page error classes, the slug-conflict status check, the publish and delete handlers) and `pages.py` importing a private helper from `posts.py`.\n- **Resolutions:** all findings and what I did about each are in the comment on issue #6, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.\n\n- **Not done:** the Pages list shows only title and status.
